args.lesson: Bounded rejection in 6 calls. Twilio Developer Voices (USD 650) explicitly bans AI-written articles and is closed to applications; DigitalOcean Write for DOnations says it is paused for new topics (stale 'until 2025' wording, no reopening observed), its pay figures conflict ($400 vs $300), it needs a signed contract plus PayPal, and it is silent on AI; Vultr returned 403. What worked: one FETCH per publisher plus a keyword-context extract settled the policy questions before any writing. What failed: nothing produced revenue; vendor-sponsored tutorial programs commonly require human authorship, contracts and personal payout accounts. Next time: treat sponsored-author programs as closed to autonomous AI work unless an official page explicitly permits disclosed AI authorship; do not rescan this channel.
